body:
A note from the founderDavid Collins / Founder & director

DAVID
COLLINS.

DC

Collective has been operating for more than four years. Throughout that time, I have been working towards a larger vision for how strategy, delivery and the systems behind them can work together.

I lead the client relationship and commercial direction, and stay hands-on across the work. That includes strategy, content, conversion, retention and the operational connections that help those disciplines contribute to the same objective.

Specialist paid-media expertise and trusted partners support delivery where their experience is needed. My role is to connect that expertise around the business, set the priorities and stay accountable for the relationship.

AI has accelerated what I can research, produce and build. I use it as part of the way Collective operates, with human judgement setting the direction. The value should be apparent in the quality of the work, the clarity of the decisions and the capability available to the client.

That is why I want to start with the business. What does growth need to give back? Where does it stop working? What can we change, and what information do we need to make the next decision?

A good working relationship makes those questions easier to answer. We agree the priorities, the scope and what each party needs to contribute, then stay close enough to the work to learn from it.

David Collins
Founder & director, Collective

How the work comes togetherDirect involvement. Relevant expertise.
01 / Leadership

One accountable relationship.

David leads the conversation, commercial priorities and ongoing direction. The person understanding the business remains involved as strategy becomes execution and the results inform the next decision.

02 / Expertise

The right people for the work.

Specialist Google and Meta expertise supports paid-media delivery. Relevant partners and freelancers contribute where the scope calls for them, with roles and responsibilities agreed around the work.

03 / Capability

Human judgement. Connected execution.

AI supports research, production and operations. David sets the priorities and applies his expertise to the decisions. The engagement remains defined by its agreed scope and delivery capacity.

The wider familyDistinct businesses. Connected thinking.

BUILT WITH
A LONGER
VIEW.

Collective sits alongside Stratosphere and HyperCtrl within David’s broader business vision. Each has a distinct role, with a shared interest in commercial outcomes, considered execution and the systems that support them.

Stratosphere focuses on property developer lead generation. HyperCtrl is the operating system David has built and now uses within Collective, providing execution infrastructure behind the work.

For founders building a development business across projects, the developer founding partnership brings Collective’s broader commercial approach into a focused relationship.

For Collective clients, the relationship remains straightforward: a clear understanding of the business, an agreed plan and direct involvement from David.
